mapper.sql:
SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, r.session_id AS sessionId, u.username AS userName, u.nickname AS userNickname, s.session_title AS sessionName, r.query_text AS queryText, r.rewritten_query AS rewrittenQuery, r.retrieved_chunks AS retrievedChunks, r.model_mode AS modelMode, r.model_name AS modelName, r.prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, r.completion_tokens AS completionTokens, r.latency_ms AS latencyMs, ROUND(r.latency_ms / 1000.0, 3) AS latencySec, r.success_flag AS successFlag, r.error_message AS errorMessage, DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM rag_call_log r LEFT JOIN rbac_user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN chat_session s ON r.session_id = s.id
AND (r.query_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.rewritten_query LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND r.model_name = #{modelName}
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.id DESC
